rules.title: Modbus Write Single Coil to Monitored Conpot Endpoint

detection_logic.summary: Alerts on Modbus TCP Write Single Coil requests using function code 5 directed to 10.10.20.10 on TCP port 502.
detection_logic.suricata_rule: alert tcp any any -> 10.10.20.10 502 (msg:"JANUS OT Modbus Write Single Coil to monitored endpoint"; flow:to_server; app-layer-protocol:modbus; modbus: function 5; sid:1002001; rev:1;)

evidence_references.label: attack
evidence_references.relevance: Attack evidence record has network.destination_ip 10.10.20.10, network.destination_port 502, network.protocol modbus_tcp, and data.function_code 5.

evidence_references.label: attack
evidence_references.relevance: Attack evidence record has network.destination_ip 10.10.20.10, network.destination_port 502, network.protocol modbus_tcp, and data.function_code 5 for the restoration write.

evidence_references.label: baseline
evidence_references.relevance: Baseline evidence record has network.destination_ip 10.10.20.10, network.destination_port 502, network.protocol modbus_tcp, and data.function_code 1 rather than function code 5.

expected_attack_result.expected_behavior: Each observed Modbus function-code-5 request to 10.10.20.10:502 is expected to alert; the provided attack evidence includes function-code-5 requests at packet numbers 83 and 133.

expected_baseline_result.expected_behavior: Baseline records containing Modbus function-code-1 reads are expected not to match this function-code-5 rule.

limitations: The rule identifies a Modbus Write Single Coil request, not attacker identity or intent.
Authorized maintenance, restoration, commissioning, or testing that uses function code 5 against 10.10.20.10:502 will alert.
The rule cannot distinguish a controlled write from a restoration write.
The rule is scoped only to 10.10.20.10:502 and does not cover other OT assets, Modbus write functions, or protocols.
Detection depends on Suricata observing the request and parsing Modbus traffic.

deployment_target.description: Suricata instance on the pfSense interface that observes IT-to-OT Modbus traffic
